title: ze_surf_hp
description:
Port from CS:GO 

 Map Features: 

- 7 special surf levels (health will be awarded for passing)
- 5 defense locations
- Scattered on the map, heals, anti-heals, random heals
- For zombies, the goal is not only to infect all people, but also to try to collect all their cubes (for each, 15 health is taken away from all people)
- Boss + lasers

 Items: 

- 1 Item for people (double push zombies)
- 1 Item for zombies (crossbow with 3 shots - each takes 5 health from people)
- 2 Secret item

- Map for 1 stage
